title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Instead of sitting here, why don't we walk out together?

title: Talk 1
original: I'm in the starting lineup for next week's football match. Come watch the game!

title: Talk 2
original: If you know how we can improve my G52 Tactical Shield, please submit a test application. I'll be there anytime.

title: Talk 3
original: Ease up, there's nothing to be nervous about. Should I invite Tachanka to dance a little ballet for you?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: The doctors don't test me because I'm sick. They test me because I'm too healthy. Good thing I'm not afraid of needles!

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Flash! Bash! Kapow! That's all you need to know.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Not only am I sweet, but I've got a great sense of humor.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: If you find something interesting to play with, count me in.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: We have a responsibility to look after one another. I take that very seriously.

title: Idle
original: This is really interesting, but not to me.

title: Onboard
original: RAINBOW Operator, codename Blitz. Give the order and I'll bash 'em in the face with my shield!

title: Watching Battle Record
original: This is pretty good. The popcorn, I mean. Want some?

title: Promotion 1
original: Medals, awards, promotions. They go really well with my shield, don't you think?

title: Promotion 2
original: I don't like photos of myself. The lighting is always wrong.

title: Added to Squad
original: Should we go get the bad guys maybe? Just a suggestion.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Remember: point your guns at the bad guys.

title: Depart
original: Let's look alive out here.

title: Begin Operation
original: Bad guys in our way!

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: Do think I have time to use the bathroom?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: If anyone needs to sneeze, do it now.

title: Deployment 1
original: Let's go!

title: Deployment 2
original: Move, quickly!

title: In Battle 1
original: Kapow!

title: In Battle 2
original: Boom!

title: In Battle 3
original: Surprise!

title: In Battle 4
original: Do you like it!

title: 4-star Result
original: Are we good? Can we go home now?

title: 3-star Result
original: Everything will be fine, I'm here after all.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: Am I going to need to save all your asses again?

title: Operation Failure
original: Dammit, did anyone remember to bring the ammo?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Let's go say hello to our neighbors first.

title: Tap
original: Wow!

title: Trust Tap
original: You should invite me over for dinner. We are friends, after all.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: Greeting
original: Is it time to go?
